name: get_receipt
description: Fetch the stored outcome receipt and live run for an attestation hash. run.status is completed, running, failed or incomplete; run.outcome_status adds cancelled and partially_completed, and run.step_status gives each step. deliverables lists each completed step's output with a 10-minute download URL, and credits breaks down the order's credits (both need the key's read scope). The local logo stub is not a deliverable. Unauthenticated production returns NOT_LIVE.

hash.description: SHA-256 attestation hash from quote or execute.
